name: tripdistill-static
description: Static TripDistill travel guides for Cloudflare Pages

scripts.audit:i18n: node scripts/test-i18n-literals.mjs && node scripts/test-i18n-locale-scripts.mjs --scan-reviewed && node scripts/test-i18n-translation-coverage.mjs && npm run i18n:approve && node scripts/audit-translations.mjs
scripts.localize: npm run i18n:approve && npm run localize:pages
scripts.audit: npm run audit:i18n && npm run localize:pages && npm run audit:vietnam && npm run audit:australia && npm run audit:usa && npm run audit:canada && npm run audit:switzerland && npm run audit:france && npm run audit:united-kingdom && npm run audit:italy && npm run audit:photo-license-inventory && npm run audit:nyc && npm run audit:usa-editorial && node scripts/audit-site.mjs
scripts.deploy:trip: npm run audit && npm run build && npx wrangler@latest pages deploy dist --project-name trip
scripts.deploy:japan-overview-qa: npm run audit && npm run build && npm run build:hokkaido-qa-harness && npm run check:hokkaido-qa-harness && npm run build:japan-overview-qa-harness && npm run check:japan-overview-qa-harness && npx wrangler@latest pages deploy dist --project-name trip --branch hokkaido-qa && npm run check:japan-overview-qa-harness-live
scripts.deploy:tokyo-qa: npm run audit && npm run build && npm run build:tokyo-qa-harness && npm run check:tokyo-qa-harness && npx wrangler@latest pages deploy dist --project-name trip --branch tokyo-qa && npm run check:tokyo-qa-harness-live
scripts.deploy:kyoto-qa: npm run audit && npm run build && npm run build:kyoto-qa-harness && npm run check:kyoto-qa-harness && npx wrangler@latest pages deploy dist --project-name trip --branch kyoto-qa && npm run check:kyoto-qa-harness-live
scripts.deploy:osaka-qa: npm run audit && npm run build && npm run build:osaka-qa-harness && npm run check:osaka-qa-harness && npx wrangler@latest pages deploy dist --project-name trip --branch osaka-qa && npm run check:osaka-qa-harness-live
scripts.deploy:hokkaido-qa: npm run audit && npm run build && npm run build:hokkaido-qa-harness && npm run check:hokkaido-qa-harness && npx wrangler@latest pages deploy dist --project-name trip --branch hokkaido-qa && npm run check:hokkaido-qa-harness-live
